description: Rotate PDF pages that came out sideways — rotate selected pages or the whole document by 90°, 180° or 270°, then download the fixed PDF.

faqs.a: The rotation is written into the PDF file itself, so it stays fixed in every reader and printer.
Yes — specify individual pages or ranges like “1, 4-6”, or choose “All pages”.
faqs.q: Can I rotate only some pages?

faqs.a: pdf-lib adds the rotation to each page's existing rotation value, so two 90° turns equal 180° — it never degrades quality.
No — your PDF never leaves your device.

howto: Choose which pages to rotate (or all pages).
Click “Rotate & download” to save the fixed PDF.
title: PDF Page Rotator
